<thought>To propose a single-step retrosynthesis using the Peterson reaction, I need a template that forms a C=C double bond while breaking a Si–C (trimethylsilyl) bond and an O–C (alcohol) bond. I will search the template catalog for such a forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "alcohol"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C double bond"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
